name: Databricks SQL
description: A Databricks panel for RustGIS: sign in with a Databricks CLI profile, browse Unity Catalog for GEOMETRY / GEOGRAPHY tables, and add them, or any SQL, as layers. Filter to the current view or a box you draw, so big tables stay on the warehouse.
author: Jhonatan Garrido-Lecca

commands.label: Connect
commands.help: Sign in with a Databricks CLI profile and pick a SQL warehouse (from the panel, or params).
commands.params: {"profile": "CLI profile", "warehouse_id": "SQL warehouse id"} (or the panel's form)

commands.label:
Browse
Spatial Tables
commands.help: List tables with GEOMETRY / GEOGRAPHY columns in a catalog (and optional schema).

commands.label:
Add
Table
commands.help: Add the selected (or named) Unity Catalog table as a layer.

commands.label:
Add Table
in a Box
commands.help: Add the selected table, only the rows inside a box drawn on the map.
commands.params: {"table": "catalog.schema.table", "bbox": [west, south, east, north]} (or the panel's pick)

commands.label:
SQL
Layer
commands.help: Run a SELECT on the warehouse and add the result as a layer.

commands.label:
Select
Table
commands.help: Show details of the table chosen in the panel.

commands.label:
Refresh
Panel
commands.help: Redraw the Databricks panel from the saved connection.

panel.title: Databricks
panel.help: Browse Unity Catalog and add spatial tables or SQL from a Databricks SQL warehouse.

items.label: Connection
items.text: Not connected. Enter a Databricks CLI profile and a SQL warehouse ID, then Connect.

items.label: Catalog
items.help: Choose a catalog to list its spatial tables.

items.label: Selected table
items.text: Choose a table in the tree.

items.label: Only the current view
items.help: Filter on the warehouse with ST_INTERSECTS against the map view.
